rappel_detail.station: The notch at the foot of the East Ridge, above the short Class 3-4 rock step into the gully.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional: downclimb or rappel the short rock step into the gully, then descend the snow finger and the South Defile.
hazards: Watch for moats on both sides of the snow finger and for snow blocks loosening as the day warms.

set.rappels: 1 optional short rappel over the Class 3-4 rock step at the notch; otherwise downclimbed
